name: Decode Google News real publisher URLs and AI article digest with Apify

parameters.content:
## Decode Google News real publisher URLs & AI digest

Fetch bounded Google News search results, decode opaque `news.google.com/rss/articles/...` wrapper links into real publisher URLs, extract plain-text article bodies, and summarize tagged market signals (`funding_mna`, `product_launch`, `layoff_risk`, `partnership`, `controversy_legal`, `earnings_growth`).

1. In **Run Google News Extractor**, add a **Header Auth** credential with Name `Authorization` and Value `Bearer <your Apify API token>`. Keep tokens only in n8n Credentials.

2. Run **Try once manually** to test the 10-article sample. Edit `queries`, `language`, and `timeRange` in the JSON body for your own topics.

3. Inspect **Summarize decoded articles & signals**. Enable **Daily schedule (off)** only after configuring your workflow timezone and optional downstream delivery.

The request caps Apify charges at US$0.25 per run with `LIMITED_PERMISSIONS`. [Actor and current pricing](https://apify.com/ttyan0111/google-news-ai-article-extractor). Published by `ttyan0111`, the template author.
